summary: The description promises a `ContMDiff.isImmersion_of_leftInverse` lemma, but the diff doesn't add it; the section-is-an-immersion argument is written inline instead. One step also closes a goal with a bare `rfl` that depends on the tangent-space wrapper unfolding, with no comment.
